headline: J.J. McCarthy traded to Giants: Will he succeed in New York?
summary: With Jaxson Dart out for the season, the Giants dealt a fifth-round pick to Minnesota for McCarthy. But does this move the needle for New York? Can it work?

headline: John Harbaugh: Giants have to overcome the shock of losing our QB and best defensive player
summary: Last Monday night the Giants lost starting quarterback Jaxson Dart for the season, and on Sunday they lost pass rusher Brian Burns for the season.

headline: Dolphins put De'Von Achane on injured reserve
summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane's season is over after he suffered a torn ACL in Sunday's loss to the Chiefs and the Dolphins made a roster move related to the injury on Monday.

headline: Chargers' Jim Harbaugh on struggling Justin Herbert: 'Be better'
summary: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh offered a rare public critique of Justin Herbert on Monday, imploring the quarterback to "be better."
